note: Woolford PP, ~50 km SW of Lethbridge (Hwy 5 then Hwy 503), on a cottonwood bench with the St. Mary River below. Some sites are well-treed and sheltered, others open to the sky (good stargazing); a few are 'Double' campsites set close together for groups camping side by side. No firewood is sold: bring or buy it locally. --Claude
